query:
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.title,
    first_user_message.content AS "first_user_message?",
    last_message.content AS "last_message_preview?",
    COALESCE(message_counts.message_count, 0) AS "message_count!",
    s.created_at,
    s.updated_at
FROM chat_sessions s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m.content
    FROM chat_messages m
    WHERE m.session_id = s.id
      AND m.role = 'user'
    ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC
    LIMIT 1
) AS first_user_message
    ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m.content
    FROM chat_messages m
    WHERE m.session_id = s.id
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS last_message
    ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS message_count
    FROM chat_messages m
    WHERE m.session_id = s.id
) AS message_counts
    ON true
WHERE s.organization_id = $1
  AND s.user_id = $2
  AND s.account_id = $3
  AND s.type = 'ACCOUNT_CHAT'
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC
